terms.gloss: ha! well! (joyful surprise, as at meeting someone)
evidence: Plaut. As. 2.4.43: ehem, optimē! quam dūdum tū advēnistī? (Lewis & Short)
terms.comment: Traupman gives it for “yippee!”; Lewis & Short defines it as a cry of joyful surprise, so it suits a happy “oh!” on seeing someone more than a cheer. For “hooray!”, iō! or euax!.

phrases.english: “Hooray, seven! I’ve been on seven vehicles!”
